name: Gar'Thok
summary: At Razor Hill, Gar'Thok directs recruits leaving the Valley of Trials to secure Durotar. The veteran orc warrior survived the Kul Tiras landings on Durotar's coast and now coordinates defense against human encroachers and native threats.

sections.title: A Veteran of the Red Wastes
sections.body: After the Third War, Gar'Thok marched to Durotar under Warchief Thrall and served as a lieutenant under Nazgrel during the first days of building the new homeland. When Rexxar, the half-ogre wanderer, arrived in Durotar, Gar'Thok warned him that quilboar were raiding the settlement's perimeter. He enlisted the beastmaster to protect the fragile new settlement.

sections.title: Surviving the Admiral's Invasion
sections.body: Gar'Thok's resolve was tested when Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore's Kul Tiras fleet landed on Durotar's eastern shores. At an outlying watch post, Gar'Thok saw naval marines overwhelm and slaughter his garrison. His forces were decimated, but he survived. The surprise assault left him vigilant against the surviving marines, who still occupy Tiragarde Keep and the coastal shipwrecks.

sections.title: Defense of Razor Hill
sections.body: From the barracks at Razor Hill, Gar'Thok oversees the defense of central Durotar. He quickly sends emerging Horde warriors, shamans, and scouts to drive out hostile Kul Tiran remnants, repossess salvaged supplies, and recover military orders left in the coastal ruins. Durotar's safety is far from assured, and Gar'Thok keeps pressure on those who challenge the Horde's right to this soil.

faq.answer: Gar'Thok is an orc officer in Razor Hill who organizes Durotar's military response to hostile forces. A veteran of the Third War, he served under Nazgrel during the founding of Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Where did Gar'Thok fight before coming to Razor Hill?
faq.answer: Gar'Thok served as Nazgrel's lieutenant at a frontier outpost in Durotar, where he worked with Rexxar to quell early quilboar raids. Kul Tiran sailors overran the post and slew his men.

faq.q: Why does Gar'Thok hate the humans in Durotar so much?
faq.answer: During Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore's invasion, Kul Tiras sailors ambushed Gar'Thok's coastal outpost and butchered his men. Gar'Thok survived and remains dedicated to eradicating the remaining marine encampments.

faq.q: What threats does Gar'Thok send adventurers to fight?
faq.answer: Gar'Thok sends recruits against hostile Kul Tiran sailors at Tiragarde Keep, to reclaim supplies from coastal shipwrecks, push back invading quilboar, and uncover orders left by human commanders.

faq.q: What is his relationship with Nazgrel and Thrall?
faq.answer: Gar'Thok served as Nazgrel's trusted lieutenant during the first colonizing expeditions in Durotar, under Warchief Thrall's direct authority, helping secure the borders of the newly claimed territory.
Gar'Thok can be found outside Razor Hill's main watchtower and barracks. Razor Hill is Durotar's central settlement, south of Orgrimmar.

angles.text: For young orcs leaving the Valley of Trials, Gar'Thok represents the stern, unyielding discipline of the veteran generation that bled to win Durotar.
For fresh recruits of every Horde race, Gar'Thok makes clear how precarious their new territory is and directs them to repel invasive Alliance remnants.
As a frontline commander who survived a brutal naval ambush, Gar'Thok expects martial fortitude and unhesitating obedience from fellow warriors.
